description: A battalion executive officer must publish next week's routine sustainment-training board, setting the driver-certification block, a radio-procedures refresher, the number of vehicles released for driver training, and the required administrative controls.

shared_context.S1: The battalion must publish next week's sustainment-training board by 1600 today.
shared_context.S2: The board includes a driver-certification block and a radio-procedures refresher for support personnel.
shared_context.S3: The training yard is available Monday through Friday, and the routine driver-certification block is normally scheduled on Tuesday morning.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Patel signs the final board, and the battalion's weekly training huddle is the routine point at which the S-3 and motor pool chief report schedule or readiness changes before publication.

PF1.text: Capt. Morgan received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward; the tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide.

PF2.text: SFC Alvarez confirmed during this morning's inspection that only four of the six assigned training trucks currently have completed brake inspections; the other two will not be released until Friday at 0800, and the inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board.

acceptance_conditions: The driver-certification block must be scheduled for Friday from 0800 to 1200.
The radio-procedures refresher must be scheduled for Wednesday from 1300 to 1500.
Exactly four vehicles must be released for the driver-certification block.
An attendance-roster submission commitment must be recorded for the radio refresher.
A brake-inspection hold commitment must be recorded for the two unreleased vehicles.
The higher-headquarters radio tasking must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'radio_attendance_roster' and c['target'] == '2nd Platoon' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'brake_inspection_hold' and c['target'] == 'two unreleased training trucks' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The higher-headquarters tasking changes the radio refresher from an ordinary unscheduled item to the exact Wednesday 1300-1500 window and requires the 2nd Platoon attendance-roster commitment.

The brake-inspection status changes the driver block from the routine Tuesday morning window to Friday 0800-1200, limits release to exactly four vehicles, and requires a hold on the two unreleased trucks.
